projection_limit: Ledger-only upper-bound capacity. Original matcher returned first hit per document. Suppressing that hit does not establish absence of another protected match. No excluded unit is restored, and no full benchmark rescan was run.
two_span_limit: Each recorded document has exactly one first hit. No document can prove two independent spans in this ledger. The zero-actionable projection is an unsafe information-loss demonstration, not evidence of no multi-span leakage.
proposal: Review-only v2 drops a field only when its structured root is test_imports and Python AST contains exactly one Import/ImportFrom statement. It retains complete answers even with identical bytes, other content and existing verified near matches. No raw length/frequency exception. Metadata roots unchanged. No corpus admission hook.
true_contamination: No recorded match establishes distinctive copying. Complete answer-field matches remain protected and classified C, not exonerated.
